text_block_list.text:
With her sights set firmly on the first race of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho,
Verxina diligently stacked up her training.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Then, onto the next menu item—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmphhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

"I had scheduled a workout using the same chest expander
for right after this. I worried that might lead to making
too many comparisons again, but..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No, as planned.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Going out of your way to rearrange things
would just show that you're overthinking it."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I shall give it my all,
with the intensity set to maximum.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
I'm... a strong Umamusume too, after all!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuughhh...!!

A load that's just right for Gentildonna is far too heavy for the current Verxina...
The stark difference between them right now was laid plain to see.
During the next training session as well—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Gentildonna...!
She really does have incredible power.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Preparing for heavy track conditions, perhaps? To tackle that muddy uphill slope
with such effortless ease..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aren't the tracks where she ran
way too torn up?!
Just how much leg power does she have...?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I shall take my leave as well.
choice_data_list: Try to avoid running on the inside as much as you can.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...The trail she left behind in her wake, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect. In the actual race,
you may not always have the luxury to choose your path.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Taking the harshest path—
I shall push through the inside!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Guh... It's so hard to run...!
...Ngh, just how deep is this...!!

Tripped up by the mud and the ruts left
in the wake of Gentildonna's run,
Verxina's breath grew ragged. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will never!
Ever give up...!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...gh...,
Something like this... is nothing... to me...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...! However,
please let me rest for just 10 minutes...
choice_data_list: (She did say not to be so self-conscious, but...)

text_block_list.text:
"For Verxina, who aims for the top,
Gentildonna's presence towering over her must loom incredibly large."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps I should retrain myself on a rougher track.
Right around that time, another "peak" became the talk of the town—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Hear me, my people.
I shall ask you once more."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Where is the light you should revere?
—Who is your king?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, shout it.
Call out the name of Orfevre!

Her name is Orfevre...
On this year's Classic Triple Crown trail, she's won the Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and—
"Claiming victory in the Kikuka-sho, she became the seventh Classic Triple Crown Umamusume in history. A valiant and imperious 'King.'"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaaaaaaaaah...!!
Orfevre~~~~~!!
Congratulations~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...As expected of you, Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Those who stand at the very top really do...
have a charisma that draws people to them."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Just like her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...
It's not about Gentil-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: There was someone I really looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the top is the best way to lead my little sisters...
The person who instilled that conviction in me—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She's broken clean away! She's surging forward!!
Spreading wings of dreams... now!
She blows past them in the final stretch, aaaand it's overrr!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Orfe-san, that person took the racing world
by storm with their overwhelming strength."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing her reach the pinnacle...
that's what inspired me to become strong."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I can feel an overwhelming aura from Orfe-san right now,
reminiscent of that person.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And... yes,
indeed it is.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating to admit, but...
Ms. Gentile truly has a way of captivating people as well.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"In that same vein,
she likely has what it takes to stand at the top."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...However, the same applies to me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"One day, I shall claim the crown.
Even I possess the caliber worthy of the pinnacle!"

I could feel a clear sense of pride and confidence
from Verxina as she declared it.
Even so, after all—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...For now, she is still
undoubtedly the stronger one, but..."

Gentildonna's image is etched into Verxina's mind...
In that case, what I need to tell her is—
choice_data_list: You have a strength that surpasses hers.
You have a strength that can surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Never giving up—that's what tenacity is.

text_block_list.text:
She has faced Gentildonna time and again,
feeling the gap in their strength each time.
Even so, she continues to challenge her.

Having bounced back after nearly breaking so many times,
Verxina possesses the strength to face any hardship.
However—

Gentildonna has yet to learn defeat. In the midst of
a grueling race... that difference will undoubtedly
show itself in that very final stride.
choice_data_list: Standing at the pinnacle in the end... will be you.
Standing at the pinnacle in the end... will be you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course.
That is what I truly believe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainers really are amazing, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (I said it like that, but... the truth is, I did waver just a little.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(If she manages to stand shoulder to shoulder with that idolized figure...
After all, she is "the strongest".)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(They're not just watching my training, but me as a person...
They really do look out for me.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (For Trainer's sake, too, I have to become stronger—)
...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Verxina-san...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Win Variation-san...
A senior one generation above me.
Come to think of it, she also—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Good work today.
The Kikuka Sho, was it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank... you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Well, there's a monster in my generation.
So it's pretty tough, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well, but getting 2nd place against that,
maybe you could say I put up a good fight, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Do you truly,
sincerely believe that?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...As if I'd think that!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still... there are truly ridiculous monsters out there in the world.
Sometimes things really are just plain impossible, ya know...?”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's no use.
Someone like me could never...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...They look similar.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Miss Shion.
There is someone that *for now*, I cannot beat either.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, I will become even stronger—
and I will defeat you without fail.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I shall prove to you
that there is no such thing as "definitely impossible."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Splendid.
Please keep an eye on next year's Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...
